headline: Advances in Quantum Advantage, Circuits, and Codes
summary: Today's research highlights major breakthroughs across quantum algorithms, circuit simulation limits, and Hamiltonian learning. Together, these six papers push the boundaries of quantum error correction, approximate optimization advantages, and our ability to probe complex quantum systems efficiently.

themes.title: Quantum Circuits and Simulation
themes.body: New classical algorithms and structural insights expand our understanding of shallow and constant-depth quantum circuits. Researchers have developed deterministic classical methods for estimating output probabilities and analyzed the robustness and error tolerance of circuit classes like QAC0.

themes.title: Quantum Advantage and Error Correction
themes.body: Recent advances demonstrate provable quantum advantages in approximate optimization tasks via decoded quantum interferometry, alongside new frameworks establishing that single-shot quantum codes are self-correcting with highly efficient parallel decoders.

themes.title: Hamiltonian Dynamics and Probing
themes.body: Novel protocols enable the reconstruction of unknown many-body quantum Hamiltonian dynamics using only a single measurable qubit, achieving Heisenberg-limited precision scaling with linear total query time.

connections.body: Both papers explore the fundamental properties and output behavior of quantum circuits, linking shallow circuit output probability estimation with the broader statistical behavior of random quantum circuits beyond moment matching.
